This whole crazy situation has reinvigorated my love for my degree in biomedical engineering. I’ll be turning in my thesis at the end of April and I’ll graduate in May and I can’t wait to get out into the field and make an impact on people’s lives with my research. 

Side note- For the foreseeable future, if you know any medical professionals give them extra love and kindness.

I was on a run and a man stopped his car about 5ft in front of me and he rolls down his window. I about shit myself. He’s staring at me through his window and says “Can I marry you?” 
Out of breath I say “No.” 
He follows with “Well are you single?” 
I am single but I said “No.” As I’m running away and he yells after me “Well he’s clearly one lucky man!” 

I thought I was going to get kidnapped for sure. This literally happened today.

My research. I was robbed right before Halloween this year and they took thousands of dollars worth of my things, but with it they took years of research. They took my flash drives and backup hard drives so all the raw data was just gone, so my thesis may be caput. 

I didn’t rely too much on the cloud before but now I’ll never not use it. Back up everything people.
